L2510

{operation} inside a loop

What

{operation} inside a loop

Why

A repeated copy or representation fallback can make a growing value's cost super-linear.

Fix

To keep the loop's cost linear, {fix_text}.

Worked example

First UI snapshot mentioning L2510: Tests/UILint/hidden_cost_in_loop.warn.

Warning [jet.HiddenCostInLoop]: An exact Int operation may spill to bigint inside a loop
  --> Tests/UILint/hidden_cost_in_loop.jet:5:9
    |
  5 |         total += index
    |         ^^^^^^^^^^^^^^
 Why: A repeated copy or representation fallback can make a growing value's cost super-linear.
 Fix: To keep the loop's cost linear, bound the operands so the result stays on the packed Int rail, or accept the exact bigint cost.
